description: A toy kitchen counter is in front of you with a gray refrigerator beside an oven, and some play foods on the countertop (banana, green lime, red apple, a pastry, and a burger). The left hand reaches up to the refrigerator handle and pulls the door open toward the viewer, then the right hand repeatedly picks up the lime and apple and places them into the lower fridge area, sets the banana onto the middle shelf, adds the pastry and burger inside, and finally the left hand swings the fridge door closed.
